_comment: Generic planning/groundwork epics + tickets seeded into a new game's repo by scripts/github-setup.sh. Placeholders: {title} {slug}. Keys prefixed E are epics; 'children' lists ticket keys. Ticket bodies get '**Epic:** #N' prepended and a standards footer appended. Game-specific design tickets (mechanics, traits, etc.) are added by the game designer after the init-game-prompt.md interview — keep this file generic.

epic: Tracking issue for a phase or theme
pending: Waiting on the user: a decision, credentials, or approval
area:quality: Code standards, review gates, lint enforcement

milestones.M0 Setup: Devcontainer verified, tooling/MCP, team definition, quality gates, testing foundations. Nothing game-specific ships until this is green.
milestones.M1 Design: Design docs, architecture, build plan (init-game.md). Later build phases live in the roadmap issue until approved.

footer:
---
**Standards:** every PR passes `./validate.sh all`, meets the Definition of Done in `ENGINEERING.md`, and follows `WORKFLOW.md` (PR required, reviewers run, every thread resolved). Work happens INSIDE the devcontainer.

issues.title: Epic: Groundwork 1 — Repo and devcontainer verified for an in-container agent team
issues.body:
The template devcontainer ships with Node, pnpm, Claude Code, gh (host config mounted), ripgrep, ImageMagick, ffmpeg and Playwright Chromium. Prove it all works in THIS game's container before any agent relies on it.

**Exit:** `./scripts/doctor.sh` is green in a fresh `./dev-container.sh rebuild`; a Playwright screenshot of the running lobby exists; `gh auth status` and `git push` work from inside.

issues.title: Devcontainer: scripts/doctor.sh — verify toolchain, auth, browsers and MCP endpoints in-container
issues.body:
Write `scripts/doctor.sh` (run inside the container) that checks and prints PASS/FAIL for: node/pnpm versions, `gh auth status`, `git push --dry-run` on a branch, `docker ps` for the vscode user, `rg`, `convert`, `ffmpeg`, Playwright Chromium present, `./run.sh --status` servers reachable on `PORTS.env` ports, and each `.mcp.json` server connectable (`claude mcp list`). Add a **Toolchain** section to `CLAUDE.md` listing what is available and which role uses it.

**Acceptance:** all green after `./dev-container.sh rebuild`; a red check names the fix.

issues.title: Graphics QA tooling: pnpm qa:diff (pixelmatch) wrapper and .qa/ conventions
issues.body:
Add `pixelmatch` + `pngjs` devDeps and `scripts/img-diff.ts` exposed as `pnpm qa:diff a.png b.png --threshold 0.1` (prints mismatch % and writes a diff PNG). Screenshots go to `.qa/screenshots/` (gitignored); reviewed baselines to `qa/baselines/`.

**Acceptance:** `pnpm qa:diff` on two screenshots reports a percentage and produces a diff image.

issues.title: Epic: Groundwork 2 — Agent tooling and MCP (explore the running game, GitHub, bots)
issues.body:
Every teammate must be able to *see and poke* the running game and talk to GitHub from inside the container.

**Exit:** `claude mcp list` shows playwright / {slug}-debug / angular connected; a QA agent can create a room, spawn bots, pause the sim, screenshot it, and comment on an issue with `gh`.

issues.title: MCP: verify playwright, {slug}-debug and angular servers connect in-container; document per-role usage
issues.body:
`.mcp.json` declares all three at project scope. With `./run.sh` up, confirm each connects from `claude` in `/workspace`; take one Playwright screenshot; run one `debug_list_games`; run one Angular MCP query. Record which roles use which server in `CLAUDE.md`.

**Acceptance:** `claude mcp list` all connected; the three example calls documented.

issues.title: MCP: game-specific debug tools in {slug}-debug (entities, player state, spawn, set state, pause/step, seed, balance)
issues.body:
Generic tools (`debug_list_games`, `debug_get_room`, `debug_get_connections`, `debug_get_performance`, `debug_get_game_state`) exist. Add, in `packages/server/src/mcp/handlers/game-specific.ts`: `debug_get_entities`, `debug_get_player`, `debug_spawn`, `debug_set_player`, `debug_pause` / `debug_step` / `debug_resume`, `debug_set_seed`, `debug_get_balance` / `debug_set_balance`. Stub against the echo module first; flesh out as the entity model lands. Unit tests per tool.

**Acceptance:** tools listed by the server, documented in `CLAUDE.md`, tested.

issues.title: Tooling: headless bot client for multiplayer testing (scripts/bot-client.ts + debug_spawn_bot)
issues.body:
Agents cannot open a second human's browser. `scripts/bot-client.ts` connects over `/ws` with the real protocol, joins/creates a room and runs a behaviour (`idle`, `wander`, …); `debug_spawn_bot` / `debug_remove_bot` run it in-process. Behaviours are shared with the gameplay test framework.

**Acceptance:** from one Claude session: create a room, spawn 3 bots, screenshot a 4-player game.

issues.title: MCP: evaluate a GitHub MCP server for agents (gh CLI is the default)
issues.body: Agents use the `gh` CLI (host config mounted). Evaluate wiring a GitHub MCP server (`github/github-mcp-server` or `@modelcontextprotocol/server-github`) into `.mcp.json` using `gh auth token`, for structured issue/PR tools. Record the decision in `CLAUDE.md`.

issues.title: Epic: Groundwork 3 — Team definition, context docs and merge gates
issues.body:
Define the agent team for this game, the docs each role reads on spawn, and finish the merge gates that `WORKFLOW.md` describes.

**Exit:** `/team` spawns the roster; a trivial dry-run task flows design review → implementation → code review → QA; required status checks are on the ruleset.

issues.title: Team: extend .claude/commands/team.md with the full roster, artifacts, tools and handoffs
issues.body:
Roles: team-lead, architect, engineer, game-designer, graphics-designer, ui-designer, audio-designer, code-qa, gameplay-qa, graphics-qa, devops, perf-engineer. For each: spawn params, responsibilities, the **artifact** it owns, the **tools** it uses (Playwright MCP, {slug}-debug MCP, `gh`, `pnpm qa:diff`), handoffs, definition of done. Every prompt cites `WORKFLOW.md` and the review process. Keep the architect/engineer 'must agree before coding' rule.

**Acceptance:** dry run on a trivial task completes through all roles.

issues.title: Team: canonical context docs index (docs/) and CLAUDE.md pointers
issues.body:
Establish `docs/GAME-DESIGN.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/VISUAL-STYLE.md`, `docs/TESTING.md`, `docs/CODE-STANDARDS.md`, `docs/REVIEW.md` as the sources teammates read on spawn; `CLAUDE.md` lists them and drops the template 'START HERE' banner once `init-game.md` exists.

**Acceptance:** each role prompt in `team.md` cites the docs it must read.

issues.title: Merge gates: add required status checks (validate, code-review) to the main ruleset once they exist
issues.body:
`scripts/github-setup.sh` applied a ruleset (PR required, threads resolved, no force push) but deliberately no required checks. When the CI job (`validate`) and the reviewer's `code-review` commit status exist, add both as required checks with `gh api rulesets/<id> --method PUT`. Any secret for automatic reviewers is set with `gh secret set` from the terminal, never the UI.

**Acceptance:** a test PR cannot merge with a failing/missing check or an unresolved thread.

issues.title: Epic: Groundwork 4 — Code quality standards and rigorous review gates
issues.body:
No magic strings/numbers, no duplicated real logic, SOLID, maintainable, simple, elegant, no huge files or methods, no abbreviated names. Written down, enforced by lint and duplication detection where possible, checked by a two-stage review on every PR (`WORKFLOW.md` §6).

**Exit:** `./validate.sh lint` enforces the rules; `docs/CODE-STANDARDS.md` + `docs/REVIEW.md` merged; the scaffold passes.

issues.title: Code standards: docs/CODE-STANDARDS.md (no magic values, no duplicated logic, SOLID, small units, full names, determinism)
issues.body:
Rules: every meaningful literal in a named constant or `data/*.json`; one home per behaviour; single responsibility, composition over `switch` towers, injected clock/random/transport; files ≤ 300 lines, functions ≤ 40, complexity ≤ 10, ≤ 4 params, nesting ≤ 3; no abbreviations (allow `x`, `y`, `id`), predicate booleans, unit-suffixed names; pure functions, no dead code, comments say why; simulation never touches `Math.random` / `Date.now` / `performance.now`.

**Acceptance:** doc merged; `ENGINEERING.md` DoD links to it; D2 enforces every automatable rule.

issues.title: Lint enforcement of the code standards (magic numbers, size limits, complexity, naming/abbreviations, banned globals)
issues.body:
`eslint.config.js`: `no-magic-numbers`, `max-lines 300`, `max-lines-per-function 40`, `complexity 10`, `max-params 4`, `max-depth 3`; `eslint-plugin-unicorn/prevent-abbreviations` + `id-length`; `@typescript-eslint/naming-convention`; `eslint-plugin-sonarjs` (cognitive-complexity, no-duplicate-string, no-identical-functions); `no-restricted-globals/properties` banning `Math.random`, `Date.now`, `performance.now` outside the injected implementations; no `eslint-disable` without justification.

**Acceptance:** green on the scaffold after fixes; a deliberate violation of each rule fails.

issues.title: Duplicate-code detection (jscpd) in the validation gate
issues.body:
`jscpd` devDep and a `./validate.sh duplication` step included in `all`: min 5 lines / 50 tokens, ignore test fixtures, 0 % new duplication against a committed baseline.

**Acceptance:** fails on a copy-pasted function between packages; passes on the clean scaffold.

issues.title: Review tooling: /review command that posts line-anchored PR comments and the code-review commit status; docs/REVIEW.md
issues.body:
`.claude/commands/review.md` makes a reviewer agent read a PR diff, walk `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`, post **line-anchored review comments**, and post commit status `code-review` = failure while findings are open / success when every thread is resolved. `docs/REVIEW.md` states the two-stage process from `WORKFLOW.md` §6 in role terms.

**Acceptance:** a dry-run PR is reviewed end-to-end with it.

issues.title: Conventions for constants, enums and config: where every number and string lives
issues.body:
`packages/shared/src/constants/` for protocol/limits/physics; `data/*.json` + zod loaders for designer-tunable values (hot-reload on server); `const` unions for ids/kinds; client render constants in `render/constants.ts` only. Refactor the echo module and message router to use them.

**Acceptance:** documented in `docs/CODE-STANDARDS.md#constants`; scaffold refactored.

issues.title: Epic: Groundwork 5 — Testing foundations: unit, integration, gameplay framework, seeded determinism
issues.body:
All code is unit and integration tested, and gameplay is testable as scripted, seeded playthroughs.

**Exit:** two seeded gameplay scenarios pass against the echo module; coverage thresholds active; CI check `validate` on PRs.

issues.title: Seeded random number system in packages/shared (RandomSource, per-subsystem streams, injected everywhere)
issues.body:
`packages/shared/src/random/`: small PRNG (xoshiro128** or mulberry32) behind `RandomSource` (`nextFloat`, `nextInt`, `pick`, `shuffle`, `fork(label)`); `GameSessionConfig.seed` (lobby generates one, shown in UI/debug MCP) forks independent child streams per subsystem. `GameModuleFactory` receives it; nothing in the sim calls `Math.random`.

**Acceptance:** same seed ⇒ same sequence; forks independent; a 10 000-tick sim with a fixed seed yields an identical state hash twice.

issues.title: Deterministic simulation contract: injected clock, fixed timestep, stable ordering, state hash, replay from seed + inputs
issues.body:
`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#determinism` + scaffolding: `Clock` interface injected into room/module (manual clock in tests); fixed-step accumulator; stable iteration order; `computeStateHash(state)`; replay format `{ seed, config, inputs[] }` and `replay()`.

**Acceptance:** an integration test runs the module under a manual clock and asserts hash equality across two runs.

issues.title: Gameplay testing framework: headless scenario runner with a scripting DSL, bots, replays and assertions
issues.body:
`scenario(name, { seed, players }).at(tick, player(n).input(...)).every(...).run(seconds(90)).expect(state => …)` driving the real `GameRoom` + `GameModule` with the manual clock and seeded RNG; bot behaviours shared with `scripts/bot-client.ts`; query helpers over snapshots; failing runs write a replay to `qa/replays/`; `pnpm test:gameplay` is part of `./validate.sh test`.

**Acceptance:** two scenarios pass against the echo module (movement echo, late join).

issues.title: Testing standards: docs/TESTING.md, coverage thresholds in vitest, unit vs integration vs gameplay
issues.body:
Unit (all logic), integration (`*.integration.test.ts` across subsystems), gameplay (rules/balance changes), UI (component + Playwright smoke). Coverage thresholds in each `vitest.config.ts` (shared 95 %, server 90 %, client 80 %); flaky-test policy; builders convention; no large snapshot tests.

**Acceptance:** thresholds active and passing on the scaffold; PR template references it.

issues.title: Client testing foundations: vitest for pure client modules, Playwright smoke script, deterministic screenshot hooks
issues.body:
Client math in framework-free modules with vitest; `scripts/e2e-smoke.ts` (lobby → create → start, canvas renders, no console errors); dev-only `window.__{slug}Debug` with `pause()`, `step(n)`, `setSeed()` mirroring the debug MCP.

**Acceptance:** `pnpm test` covers client modules; smoke passes in-container against `./run.sh`.

issues.title: Validation gate and CI: validate.sh all = lint + duplication + typecheck + unit + integration + gameplay + coverage; GitHub Actions job `validate`
issues.body:
Extend `./validate.sh` so `all` runs every gate and prints one summary table; add `.github/workflows/validate.yml` (job name **`validate`**) running it on PRs with a pnpm cache. Then C3 makes it required.

**Acceptance:** the check appears on a PR and fails on a seeded violation.

issues.title: Epic: Groundwork 6 — Game design ({title})
issues.body:
Turn the concept into reviewed design documents before any gameplay code. The game designer adds mechanic-specific tickets under this epic after the `init-game-prompt.md` interview.

**Exit:** `docs/GAME-DESIGN.md` and `docs/VISUAL-STYLE.md` reviewed by the user; all `needs-decision` items resolved.

issues.title: Game Design Document: core fantasy, loop, session model, controls, camera, win/lose, non-goals
issues.body:
Write `docs/GAME-DESIGN.md` for {title}: core fantasy, moment-to-moment loop, session length and player count, modes (decide FFA / co-op / both), late join, respawn, round end, controls and camera, difficulty curve, explicit v1 non-goals. Log open questions as `needs-decision` tickets assigned to the user (see `WORKFLOW.md` §2).

**Acceptance:** reviewed with the user.

issues.title: Visual style guide: palette, motion language, asset vocabulary -> docs/VISUAL-STYLE.md
issues.body:
Define the look before drawing, per `ASSET-GENERATION.md` (code-drawn, layered, palette-disciplined, animated, silhouette-legible): palette incl. six player hues, motion language, UI type, reference sheet as inline SVG/Canvas mock in `docs/visual/`.

**Acceptance:** reviewed by the user; graphics-qa derives its checklist from it.

issues.title: Onboarding, HUD information design and key prompts (UX wireframes)
issues.body: First 60 seconds without a modal tutorial; HUD contents; any timed prompts must not stall multiplayer; death/respawn screen; keyboard accessibility. Wireframes in `docs/ui/` and a component list for the engineer.

issues.title: Audio direction manifest (opt-in pipeline; generation deferred until the game is playable)
issues.body: Per `AUDIO-PIPELINE.md`: write the prompt manifest (ambient, SFX, stings). `./ai-pipeline.sh check` is offline; `sync` costs money and needs `GEMINI_API_KEY` + `GOOGLE_CLOUD_TTS_API_KEY` in `.env` and explicit user approval. Generation is deferred until the game is playable.

issues.title: Epic: Groundwork 7 — Architecture and the build plan (simulation, networking, renderer spike, init-game.md, roadmap)
issues.body:
The technical design the build phases will execute, and the template's `init-game.md` build plan generated from the interview. Ends with the roadmap turned into approved epics.

**Exit:** `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` reviewed (engineer agrees), renderer decided with numbers, `init-game.md` has no placeholders, user approves the roadmap.

issues.title: Architecture: server simulation design (entity model, fixed-step reduce, spatial queries, snapshot contents, MCP state)
issues.body:
`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#simulation`: entity model in `packages/shared`, what the server is authoritative for vs client-cosmetic, spatial partitioning, determinism/seeding, `GameSnapshot` shape and size budget, interest management, `getRoomGameState` contents, perf budget.

**Acceptance:** engineer agrees; budget stated.

issues.title: Architecture: networking (GameInput, snapshot interpolation/prediction, snapshot rate, schemas, GameSessionConfig)
issues.body:
`GameInput` shape with seq numbers; client interpolation + own-entity prediction; sim 60 Hz vs snapshot rate; `message-schemas.ts` changes; `GameSessionConfig` fields (incl. `seed`, `mode`). Trust model stays client-trust (local-only).

**Acceptance:** documented; engineer agrees.

issues.title: Architecture decision: client renderer (Canvas2D vs WebGL/Pixi) — spike with measured numbers
issues.body:
Spike both on a throwaway branch at the game's expected entity counts in headless Chromium and a real browser; consider Angular integration (zoneless, `game-setup.ts` seam), bundle size, and deterministic screenshots. Explain the consequences to the user in plain language (visual ceiling vs engineering cost) and let them confirm.

**Acceptance:** decision + numbers in `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#renderer`.

issues.title: Run the template interview and generate init-game.md (build plan with no placeholders)
issues.body:
`init-game-prompt.md` interviews the user and overwrites `init-game.md` with exact files/edits for the extension points (`GameInput`/`GameSnapshot`/`GameSessionConfig`, `GameModule`, `message-schemas.ts`, `game-setup.ts`, MCP `getRoomGameState`). Do it AFTER the GDD and architecture docs exist.

**Acceptance:** no `<PLACEHOLDER>` remains; build tickets link to its sections.

issues.title: Roadmap: build phases after groundwork — NOT actionable until the user approves
issues.body: Parking lot for the phases that follow planning (core loop, progression, advanced mechanics, QA/perf/polish/release). List candidate work per phase here as design lands. When the user approves, each phase becomes its own epic with tickets derived from `init-game.md`.
